reader_summary.headline: You've heard a version of this story before.
reader_summary.overview: You've heard a version of this story before: Steve Jobs calls some executive out of the blue to come work for him. Only this time the story turns out great ... This episode of the a16z Podcast shares some of the journey that former CFO Lawrence Levy went on with Steve Jobs as they took Pixar -- a company then on the verge of failure -- to its IPO and subsequent greatest hits..

key_points.text: This episode of the a16z Podcast shares some of the journey that former CFO Lawrence Levy went on with Steve Jobs as they took Pixar -- a company then on the verge of failure -- to its IPO and subsequent greatest hits..
It's sort of an adventure story but is really more of a quest for product-market fit.
How did they figure out a model for such an old-but-new business (i.e., animation and entertainment)?
